verdict.line: You lose if you let Garen snowball to a free level 6 all-in; you win almost every extended trade once Rylai's lands and his passive regen stops mattering.

brief.thesis: Garen's Perseverance passive only matters if he's allowed to go a few seconds without taking damage, and Mordekaiser's whole kit is built to deny exactly that with constant Q (Obliterate) pokes and E (Death's Grasp) pulls. The 51.5% win rate over 3,360 games reflects a lane where you out-sustain and out-poke him pre-6, then have to survive one dangerous execute window before your core items take over.

theirWindow.when: level 6+ and his Q is up
theirWindow.what: He can flash the silence-and-gap-close into a Demacian Justice execute attempt at 400 range. Do not sit below roughly half health near him once he hits 6, and hold W (Indestructible) shield ready rather than consuming it early.

yourWindow.when: his Q and R are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Pull him in with E (Death's Grasp) and dump Q (Obliterate) plus autos. Without Q he has no silence or slow-cleanse to escape your E's pull, and without R he has no execute threat to punish your commitment.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The ring's sustain and early damage let you match his poke while you deny his Perseverance regen tick by tick; 52.1% win rate over 3,451 games on this start confirms it over the shield variant here.

boots.why: Garen's damage is almost entirely physical autos and his E (Judgment) spin; the flat reduction on repeated hits blunts both far more than magic resist would.

core.why: The slow on Q (Obliterate) and E (Death's Grasp) keeps him inside your pull range instead of walking off to let Perseverance tick.
Sustained-damage amp and the omnivamp keep you winning extended trades once his passive regen is already shut off.
Burn damage from repeated Q/E hits adds up over a trade and finishes the 55.4% win-rate build path measured over 484 games.

situational.when: he's snowballing off autos and building into crit or lifesteal
you need more healing amp to win a prolonged sustain war before item spikes
his team stacks magic resist later and you need the shred
his team has heavy additional crowd control beyond his own kit

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking adaptive damage and healing on hit directly offsets the fact that you're trading into a champion whose passive wants to regen between fights.

summoners.why: Ignite is run in 81.2% of games here because it both secures the solo-kill advantage this matchup already favors you in and permanently shuts off Garen's Perseverance regen for the duration.

playing.title: Pull before you commit Q
playing.detail: Use E (Death's Grasp) first to drag Garen into point-blank range, then follow with Q (Obliterate); this locks in his bonus single-target damage before he can walk away.

playing.title: Poke to deny his passive
playing.detail: Garen regenerates a percentage of his health per second only while unharmed; landing Q or autos on a short rotation keeps Perseverance from ever ticking.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 execute
playing.detail: Once he's 6, Demacian Justice can threaten a kill at 400 range on anyone low; don't dip below roughly half health near him until you've baited or out-leveled his R cooldown.

playing.title: Bait his Q before all-in
playing.detail: Decisive Strike gives him a speed burst, breaks slows, and silences on the next hit; if he wastes it early or it's on cooldown, that's your safest window to commit fully.

playing.title: Shield into his spin
playing.detail: Pop W (Indestructible) just before his E (Judgment) connects so the physical damage it stores converts into healing for you.

playing.title: Save R for a real commitment
playing.detail: Hold Realm of Death until after you've already landed E and Q, since it drags him away from his tower and allies once he's already locked in the trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured OP.GG numbers from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning about trade timing and passive denial is original analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Garen when he reachese level 6. Use your skills to farm and contest lane. Wait for a chance after purchasing items with armor.
